title: Baba Vanga's April 1995 prediction of the chess federation presidency
summary: Russian Republic tells of Baba Vanga's April 1995 prediction of the chess federation presidency, about 1995 at Bulgaria; Paris, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Then in the spring of 1995, in April of 95, Baba Vanga and her niece call me saying, "Kerson, come here."

plain: A man who served as president of one of Russia's republics says that in April 1995 he got a call from Baba Vanga, a Bulgarian woman known as a seer, and her niece, telling him, "Kerson, come here." He tells it as the moment she foretold that he would become president of the world chess federation, and he also points to the Guinness book. If true, it would mean she could see what was coming before it happened.
